title: Design System: Bright Pocket VPN Customer Storefront

display.purpose: The landing promise only; expressive and short.

label.purpose: Actions, fields, tabs, badges, and compact facts.

shadows.name: feature-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates the connection proof and primary operational panel from the paper canvas.

shadows.name: ledger-lift
shadows.purpose: Provides restrained depth for plan ledger rows.

shadows.name: profile-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates dashboard profile cards without making the grid feel heavy.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Visible keyboard focus with a 3px visual offset; never decorative.

motion.name: status-breathe
motion.purpose: A single restrained readiness pulse; disable entirely for reduced motion.

motion.name: state-brightness
motion.purpose: Immediate hover feedback for buttons without introducing a new hue.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default customer action, including links styled as actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--button-radius, 12px); padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--purple, #6d28d9); color: #fff; font: 800 1rem/1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 82, 'wght' 800; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .16s ease, transform .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid rgba(109,40,217,.28); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A visible alternative action with the same target size as the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 20px; background: transparent; color: var(--purple-dark, #30105f); outline: 2px solid var(--purple-dark, #30105f); font: 800 1rem/1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 82, 'wght' 800; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .16s ease, transform .16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid rgba(109,40,217,.28); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The shared labeled field for authentication, checkout, and tracking.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink, #24113f); font-family: ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { font-weight: 800; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #dfd1e9); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; padding: 10px 13px; color: var(--ink, #24113f); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--purple, #6d28d9); outline: 3px solid rgba(109,40,217,.15); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field input:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Mode Tab
components.description: A compact mode selector used in authentication flows.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 20px; background: #efe6f6; color: var(--purple-dark, #30105f); font: 800 1rem/1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--purple, #6d28d9); color: #fff; } .ds-tabs button:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid rgba(109,40,217,.28); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 78px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; color: var(--ink, #24113f); font-family: 'Anybody', ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: inherit; font-weight: 850; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 32px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px 8px 15px 15px; background: var(--purple, #6d28d9); position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-brand-mark::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 5px; border: 3px solid var(--yellow, #f8d928); border-top: 0; border-left: 0; transform: rotate(35deg); left: 9px; top: 12px; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; } .ds-nav-links a { color: inherit; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid rgba(109,40,217,.28); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-action { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--purple, #6d28d9); color: #fff !important; text-decoration: none !important; }

components.css: .ds-plan { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 22px; padding: 24px 28px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--yellow, #f8d928); color: var(--ink, #24113f); box-shadow: 0 9px 24px rgba(48,16,95,.08); font-family: ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; } .ds-plan h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 800 1.5rem/1.1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-plan small { display: block; opacity: .75; } .ds-plan-price { font: 900 2.6rem/1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-plan-price small { font: 700 .85rem/1.3 ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-plan button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--purple, #6d28d9); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; } .ds-plan button:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-plan button:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid rgba(109,40,217,.28); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-plan { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; } .ds-plan button { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }

components.name: Operational Panel
components.description: The calm paper container for authentication, checkout, and tracking work.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-panel { max-width: 680px; border-radius: 16px; padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 36px); background: var(--paper, #fffdf7); color: var(--ink, #24113f); box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(48,16,95,.14); font-family: ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 800 1.5rem/1.15 'Anybody', ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted, #705f80); } .ds-panel:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(48,16,95,.14), 0 0 0 3px rgba(109,40,217,.10); }

components.css: .ds-proof { padding: 28px; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--purple-dark, #30105f); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(48,16,95,.14); transform: rotate(2deg); font-family: ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; } .ds-proof h2 { margin: 0 0 24px; font: 800 1.55rem/1.15 'Anybody', ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-proof-label { display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; background: var(--yellow, #f8d928); color: var(--ink, #24113f); font: 900 .75rem/1.2 'Anybody', ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-device { border-radius: 18px; padding: 24px; background: var(--paper, #fffdf7); color: var(--ink, #24113f); transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-device p { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin: 0; font-weight: 800; } .ds-device h3 { font: 800 1.25rem/1.2 'Anybody', ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-ready-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #22c55e; animation: ds-status-breathe 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-usage { height: 12px; margin: 16px 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 10px; background: #e9ddf4; } .ds-usage span { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--purple, #6d28d9); } .ds-same-file { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 15px; background: var(--yellow, #f8d928); transform: rotate(-3deg); } @keyframes ds-status-breathe { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,.13); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ready-dot { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Bright Pocket turns a technical VPN purchase into a colorful, legible ledger: cream paper is the desk, yellow fields hold the offer, and purple controls move the customer forward. Compressed, oversized type creates confidence without resorting to generic security imagery; compact rounded surfaces and plain body copy keep the experience approachable.

The system serves both persuasion and operation. Landing surfaces may be bold and editorial, while authentication, checkout, tracking, and dashboard surfaces become calmer and denser without changing their palette, type, controls, or friendly voice. Exact prices, quotas, speeds, terms, and device continuity always outrank decoration.

This document applies only to the customer storefront in `storefront/public`. The existing administrator interface in `public` is a separate dark operating system and must remain visually unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Cream-paper canvas with borderless yellow, purple, and deep-purple fields.
Compressed Anybody display type paired with an unforced system body face.
Ticket-like plan rows, soft offset depth, and compact 10–28px curves.
Direct language, exact numbers, 44px minimum targets, and visible purple focus.
One restrained status pulse; all motion disappears when reduced motion is requested.

rules.name: The Three-Ink Ledger Rule
rules.body: A large promotional field uses one dominant field color, one text color, and at most one contrasting action color; it does not become a rainbow.

rules.name: The Status Means Status Rule
rules.body: Green and red communicate readiness, success, or failure and never substitute for brand accents.

rules.name: The Promise, Then Proof Rule
rules.body: Use display type for one plain-language promise; move exact limits and procedural detail into body, label, and numeric styles immediately below it.

rules.name: The No Security Theater Rule
rules.body: Do not compensate for weak hierarchy with uppercase warnings, pseudo-technical monospace, shields, maps, flags, or padlock clichés.

rules.name: The One Job Per Field Rule
rules.body: Each large color field has one dominant job: offer, proof, process, summary, or action. Do not nest competing promotional compositions inside it.

rules.name: The Lift Only Objects Rule
rules.body: Apply shadow to contained objects customers manipulate or inspect; full-width color bands and the page canvas remain flat.

rules.name: The Straight Workflow Rule
rules.body: Tilt may make a proof object feel tactile, but never tilt forms, payment controls, data summaries, or dashboard cards.

dos: Do use the Bright Pocket ledger system only for customer pages under `storefront/public`.
Do lead with exact plan totals, quota, speed, duration, payment state, and device continuity.
Do maintain the yellow–purple–deep-purple plan progression where all three plans appear together.
Do preserve 44px minimum targets, semantic controls, visible focus, non-color status text, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep persuasive pages expressive and operational pages calmer while sharing the same tokens and components.
donts: Don't restyle, token-share with, or visually merge the existing dark admin interface in `public`; it is an intentionally separate unchanged system.
Don't introduce maps, flags, server claims, speed benchmarks, testimonials, payment imagery, or other unsupported VPN marketing tropes.
Don't replace exact terms with vague superlatives or hide plan math behind decorative pricing cards.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, heavy borders, or shadows on every surface.
Don't overuse pills, rotations, status colors, or animation; each is reserved for a specific role.
